author: Sample commentary (synthetic data)
headline: Departments met 68% of their FY2025 targets; the share varies from under half to nearly all by department.
paragraphs: Each cell is the share of a department's reported measures that met their target in a year. Grey cells mean fewer than three measures were reported. A high share can mean strong performance or easy targets; the integrity view separates the two.
Output measures (things done) are met more often than outcome measures (results for residents).

templates.template: FY{fy}, {depts_fmt} departments: {met_fmt} of {measures_fmt} reported measures met their target ({met_share}); outcome measures {met_share_outcome}, output measures {met_share_output}.
templates.fallback: Too few records match to summarize; widen the years or clear a filter.

caveats.text: A measure's definition can change without its name changing; the pipeline flags value jumps above 50% but cannot catch every redefinition.
